name: Abhilash Chaturvedi
tagline: Mechanical engineer working in simulation, design and automation. I check every model against real data, and say where it falls short.
intro: First Class MEng graduate from the University of Southampton, with a 13-month placement at Siemens DISW testing and automating the Simcenter FLOEFD CFD platform across two software releases. My projects cover hydrogen combustion CFD, airfoil aerodynamics, CPU heat sink design in COMSOL, a digital twin of a battery production line, and a wind tunnel pitch mechanism I designed and built.
availability: Available immediately for graduate or junior roles across the UK, in any sector. Keen to learn and get started. No visa sponsorship needed.
